newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Journalist tortured, killed in Russian town.
newsitem.headline: Journalist tortured, killed in Russian town.

text.p: A Russian journalist was tortured and then killed in the historic city of Pereslavl Zalessky, a duty officer with the local police said on Saturday.

The official said he did not know why Alexander Korkin, a member of Russia Union of Journalists, had been singled out. "It is not clear whether the violence was directed against him as a journalist or as a person," he said.

He said masked intruders had broken into Korkin's apartment and sliced off his ear and knocked out teeth before killing him. Korkin had been working in the publishing business for several years, he added.

Russian Prince Peter, later Peter the Great, built his first ships on the lake at Pereslavl Zalessky and conducted fake naval battles there. The town is on the Golden Ring of historic towns which encircles Moscow.
